name: Trackpad Pulse
author: Fred Nix
description: Your trackpad as a live instrument: fingers, taps, gestures, speed and seven days of history, on top of Trackpad Plus's per-device controls and pointer-feel curve.

barWidget.description: A glowing trackpad on the bar that lights where your fingers are. Behind it: touches, taps, scrolls, swipes, palms, distance and speed with a week of history, a finger-speed map under the acceleration curve, and every Trackpad Plus control. Right-click switches the pad off. Optimize for my hand fits the acceleration curve to a week of your own finger speeds and overshoots.
